The proposed depguard rule confines OTLP exporter modules to `internal/telemetry`. The Audit export row never says which package the leader's exporter lives in. Add "from `internal/telemetry`" to the row so that all three statements agree.

"Gates G1 to G3 and S2: pure Go, compatible license, Go 1.26 floor" leaves out G3, which the tech stack Selection criteria define as "cryptographic primitives come only from Go `crypto/...` ... Go Cryptographic Module". G3 matters here because OTLP export over TLS must work in the FIPS build. Add "crypto through the Go Cryptographic Module".

non_blocking.section: Decision outcome (Metrics row) vs ADR-0006 Telemetry row
non_blocking.suggestion: ADR-0006 says "a Ruralz go-metrics `MetricSink` forwards Raft metrics to OpenTelemetry for `/metrics` on 9902". State once, here or in More information, that the Raft sink records into Ruralz aggregates, so the two ADRs cannot be read as allowing SDK instruments on Ruralz Control.
